# dynarex

**Tag**: serialization

## 简介

The Dynarex gem creates, reads, updates or delete rows of Dynarex flavoured XML records.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/jrobertson/dynarex

- 文档: http://rorbuilder.info/project/dynarex/rdoc/index.html
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/dynarex
